item.title: Island’s $6.4B Control Plane, SoftBank’s $11B OpenAI Bonds & OpenEvidence at $15B
item.description: Bonus Friday: Island’s $400M Series F hits $6.4B as the agentic enterprise control plane; SoftBank prints ~$11.1B of high-yield notes to fund its final $10B OpenAI tranche; Business Insider reports OpenEvidence at $15B.
